title: Santoria
description: Santoria Network is public world building and civilization server where you can role play, build your own city and more!
body:
# Santoria Netwok ### IP: `play.santoria.net`
On our server you will be able to experience the best world building experience in Minecraft, from creating your town or joining a Nations you are free to write your own story. You will be able to find more info on our [Nations gamemode on this page](https://wiki.santoria.net/Nations) also make sure to read [the rules](https://wiki.santoria.net/en/rules) before starting.
Website: [https://santoria.net/](https://santoria.net/) Wiki: [https://wiki.santoria.net/](https://wiki.santoria.net/) Discord: [https://discord.com/invite/fKCuMDHW6A](https://discord.com/invite/fKCuMDHW6A)
